name: Bottom-up SVO to DAG Reduction
aliases: SVO to Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Reduction
Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) to Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Reduction
Reducing a Sparse Voxel Tree to a DAG
summary: Bottom-up SVO to DAG Reduction compresses Sparse Voxel Octrees by iteratively merging identical subtrees from leaves to root, guaranteeing a minimal Directed Acyclic Graph.
